definitions.gloss: evil scheme; plot; sinister design; dirty trick
definitions.explanation: A plan or scheme with malicious intent. Can range from serious criminal plotting to lighthearted mischief, depending on context.

examples.japanese: あの{二人|ふたり}は{何|なに}か{悪巧|わるだく}みをしているに{違|ちが}いない。
examples.english: Those two must be plotting something.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちがこそこそと{悪巧|わるだく}みをしているのを{見|み}て、{思|おも}わず{笑|わら}ってしまった。
examples.english: I couldn't help laughing when I saw the kids secretly plotting mischief.

notes:
USAGE:
{悪巧|わるだく}み can be used both seriously (criminal plots, political scheming) and playfully (children's mischief, lighthearted pranks). Context determines the gravity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪巧|わるだく}みをする (to plot something evil)
- {悪巧|わるだく}みがばれる (for a scheme to be exposed)
- {悪巧|わるだく}みを{企|たくら}む (to devise a wicked plot)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{陰謀|いんぼう} (conspiracy) is more serious and political. {企|たくら}み (scheme, plot) is neutral — it can be good or bad. {悪巧|わるだく}み specifically emphasizes the malicious intent.
